name: io.tru8/mcp-server
title: Tru8 Evidence Research
description: Structured evidence research for AI agents. Ground factual claims in source-traced evidence organized by tier (primary data / news reporting / commentary) and type (data / official / news / analysis / opinion / academic). Returns element decomposition with relationship mapping (supports / challenges / context).
_note_repository: Make repo public before submitting to MCP Registry

packages._note_package: Publish to PyPI before submitting to MCP Registry

environmentVariables.name: TRU8_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Tru8 API key (tru8_sk_...). Create at dashboard Settings > Developer. Store in env vars, never hardcode.

tools.name: tru8_check
tools.description: Evidence research for any claim or URL. Accepts max_tier (lookup/quick/full) to control depth and cost. Tier fallback: lookup → quick → full. Returns structured evidence landscape with element decomposition, source classification, and _meta (executedTier, chargedCents).

tools.name: tru8_get_result
tools.description: Retrieve a completed check with pre-computed analytics: tier/type distributions, corroboration groups, diagnostic values, timeline, per-claim dispositions.

tools.name: tru8_get_result_raw
tools.description: Retrieve raw check data without computed analytics. Smaller payload for custom post-processing.
